effect_description_eng:
While you have no face-up [Island of Adventure] security cards, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] [All Turns] All of your level 3 or higher Digimon get +2000 DP.
[Main] Add your top security card to the hand. Then, place this card face up as the top security card.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost.
